title: Full Hermes Stack Build-Out
summary: Launched Hermes from scratch: connected Google Chat via Pub/Sub, built email archive/triage automation, and set up the memory wiki with cron jobs. Afternoon sessions tackled cost control (switched Opus→Sonnet after $25 burned, set $50 cap), attempted Microsoft 365 install (hit C2R errors, ran registry resets), and hardened Homedrums with never-sleep settings and auto-login so the PC survives power loss without blocking the gateway.
